params.body:
This PR replaces #109 and #110: the same changes rebuilt on the current main, plus the rename. #109 had come to conflict with main once #108 merged, so its checks never ran.

## What changes

- **Netwerk opens on Contacten** (from #109). The tabs read Contacten, Netwerk, Omzet en aankoop, Nieuw en stil. `?tab=netwerk` still opens the graph, and an old link to a removed tab opens Contacten.
- **"Medewerkers" in the menu**, right after Overdracht (from #110, renamed from "Mensen"):
  - it shows in the office menu and in the menu of a shared link;
  - the page is called Medewerkers and lives at `/medewerkers`; the old `/overdracht/mensen` redirects there;
  - the button on Overdracht is gone;
  - the hints in a node's panel and on Gebruikers point to "Medewerkers in het menu".

## Tests

- `NetworkTest`: an old link lands on Contacten.
- `ContextEverywhereTest` opens the Netwerk tab before picking a project.
- `CarrierPeopleTest`: the page is called Medewerkers, and a shared link sees it in the menu.
- Full suite 303/303.
